title: agent-spec section 5 Suite field
item: agent-spec template §5: define the Suite field (capability = being hill-climbed, not a gate; regression = must keep passing); pass rule per suite (regression gates on pass^5 = 1 and any Forbidden event, capability reports pass rate and partial credit); drop undefined pass@1; confirm commit 0e1f523 (pytest-bdd mapping paragraph removal) is pushed.
motivation: The pytest-bdd conversion reads §5, so it must be settled first; today §5's all-trials-pass rule contradicts the lane-2 CI-lower-bound check.
notes: Keep the 0.80 threshold and no-drop check out of the spec — they are runner/CI policy. Under an hour; do before item 1. Folded into task 19 on 2026-11-15 (owner agreed).
source_chat: BDD tests vs agent eval (Nov 6); Backlog / feature-map chat (Nov 7)
